notes: The blue entrance beacon and cable are fixed objects visible at startup, 1 m inside the doorway. The robot pauses there for 1 second to activate the wired uplink. Other beacons are created at their event drops. Yellow relays are only needed when the robot is more than 10 m from every confirmed interior beacon of any color; the wider spacing reduces yellow tiles in areas already covered by blue, orange, white or yellow tiles. Known-position proximity detection; 2D edge distances; interior beacons relay logical messages over 10 m radio links to the blue entrance beacon and through its cable to the outside gateway. The outside gateway gives no direct interior radio coverage. The smaller victim-only planning margin permits the requested close approach. No camera recognition or RF propagation.
